title: Sight Reading Practice
subtitle: Five passages with glosses, no grammatical notes.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Old English poetry and prose.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Five short passages (twenty to thirty words each) from The Wanderer, The Seafarer, and Bede's Ecclesiastical History, with glosses but no grammatical notes. The student parses and translates at sight. This is the final test of Stage 3 competence.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you translate the example passage?
items.answer: Work through it word by word with your notes.

sections.heading: Up next
sections.body: Continue to the next lesson or take the capstone examination.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you can apply Sight Reading Practice to reading.
